items.title: File Widerspruch against Fahrtenbuchauflage
items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Beispielförde, Kreishaus, Förder Straße 3, 24103 Beispielförde, erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated (posted) Tue 29.09.2026. Sender is a Kreis (general administrative authority, not a tax office), so the 4-day delivery fiction applies (posted on/after 1 Jan 2025) but the delivery day is NOT moved even if it falls on a weekend/holiday. 29.09.2026 + 4 days = Sat 03.10.2026 = deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe). One-month Widerspruch period per §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the delivery day itself is not counted; the period ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number, i.e. 03.11.2026. That day is a Tuesday, not a Saturday/Sunday/public holiday in SH, so no further shift under § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG/LVwG is needed.

items.title: Start of Fahrtenbuch-keeping obligation (six months)
items.quote: Ich ordne daher an, dass Sie für dieses Fahrzeug für die Dauer von sechs Monaten ein Fahrtenbuch zu führen haben. Die Auflage beginnt mit Eintritt der Bestandskraft dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: The six-month duty to keep a Fahrtenbuch does not start on a fixed calendar date but only once the notice becomes final and binding (Bestandskraft), i.e. once the one-month Widerspruch period (ending 03.11.2026, see the deadline item above) has expired without a Widerspruch being filed, or, if a Widerspruch is filed, only after that procedure is concluded. Since it is unknown today whether a Widerspruch will be filed, the exact start (and therefore the six-month end date) cannot be determined; the earliest possible start, if no Widerspruch is filed, would be shortly after 03.11.2026.
